sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 17, 2026, against the official HCPS calendar page and the current 2027–28 Traditional and Early College printable/eReader, Flex, and Spanish calendar PDFs.
sourceReviewDetails: The printable Traditional and Early College calendar labels Winter Break as December 20–30 and lists December 31 separately as the New Year's Day holiday. The district's eReader version includes December 31 in the Winter Break range. This page uses the printable calendar's more specific categories.

The August, October, January, February, March, April, and May teacher-workday labels and ranges were checked against the printable and eReader calendars. May 29 remains visible as the Memorial Day holiday, followed by required teacher workdays May 30–31.
The Traditional & Early College calendar and the Flex calendar follow separate schedules. Spanish translations are linked as companion resources rather than merged into this page's date table.
The downloadable ICS file is a one-time import. HCPS remains the source of record for weather-related extensions, revised files, and school-specific schedule changes.
sourceNextReviewText: This page will be reviewed again if HCPS replaces a calendar PDF or announces an inclement-weather schedule change.

customSections.content: The first student day is again August 12, while the last student day moves from May 21 to May 26. Winter Break starts December 20 instead of December 21, and Spring Break shifts from March 22–26 to March 13–17.

calendarFaqs.q: Is this the official HCPS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: MySchoolDates is an independent reference based on calendar files published by Henderson County Public Schools. HCPS is the source of record for revisions, school-specific schedules, and weather changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Which HCPS calendar applies to my student?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the calendar assigned by your school or program. This page follows the Traditional and Early College calendar; families on the Flex schedule should use the official Flex calendar in the Downloads section.

calendarFaqs.q: When do HCPS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students on the Traditional and Early College calendar return Tuesday, January 4, 2028. The printable calendar lists Winter Break through December 30, followed by the December 31 holiday and a January 3 optional teacher workday.

calendarFaqs.q: When are HCPS early dismissal days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The Traditional and Early College calendar lists early dismissal at 12:00 noon on December 17, 2027 and on the last student day, May 26, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When are HCPS teacher workdays in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Optional teacher workdays are August 5, October 15, January 3, January 17, March 7, April 14, and April 17. Required teacher workdays are August 6–11, October 18, February 18, and May 30–31. These are no-school dates for students on the Traditional and Early College calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the official HCPS calendars?
calendarFaqs.a: The downloads section links the official Traditional and Early College printable/eReader, Flex, and Spanish calendar PDFs. The ICS file on this page is a one-time import for the main Traditional and Early College student-calendar dates.
